tasks.analysis: Researchers in the U.S. and Europe are taking a fresh look at some of the natural compounds found in rainwater and soil for possible medicinal applications. High - tech instruments are used to identify and extract natural products from dirt and water; the hope is that this process will lead to the discovery of new antibiotics. Although the work is painstakingly slow at present, these researchers hope to develop technologies that will allow them to quickly isolate promising compounds that could be effective treatments for often - devastating bacterial infections.
